hypothesis: The state means are approximately linear in spatial area and temporal volume. Large unexplained variation within those states may reflect differing input-view layouts; channel stride exposes that entry-state distinction.

pcvs.name: spatial_sites
pcvs.rationale: Models spatial convolution, normalization, padding, and cache-copy work.

pcvs.name: input_sites
pcvs.rationale: Models work proportional to the temporal chunk volume.

pcvs.name: warm_cache
pcvs.rationale: Models the additional operations performed with populated convolution caches.

pcvs.name: channel_stride
pcvs.rationale: Distinguishes input views with identical shapes but different channel strides, exposing layout variation hidden by the previous state grouping.
